builds.title: Night ferry lookout, Rogue 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 120 ft. Passive Perception 16, or 21 when hearing or sight applies.
builds.languages: Speaks, reads, and writes Giant Owl. Understands, reads, and writes Common, Elvish, and Sylvan. Knows Thieves’ Cant.
traits: Proficiency +2. Dexterity save +5, Intelligence save +2. Unarmored AC 13 is 10 + Dexterity 3. HP 10 is 8 + Constitution 2.
Sailor supplies Athletics, Perception, and Ship’s Passage. Rogue supplies Acrobatics, Insight, Investigation, and Stealth. Expertise doubles proficiency in Perception and Stealth.
Keen Hearing and Sight grants advantage on applicable Wisdom (Perception) checks. Reedwatch wears no armor and relies on natural attacks.
actions: Talons. Dexterity-based unarmed strike, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d8+3 piercing.
Sneak Attack. Deal an extra 1d6 piercing with Talons once per turn on a hit with advantage. An active enemy of the target within 5 ft. of it also qualifies if the roll has no disadvantage.
Flyby. Disengage as a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Reedwatch listens from above the landing. It swoops at distracted attackers and Disengages before flying clear.

builds.title: Ford keeper, Monk 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength save +1, Dexterity save +5. Unarmored Defense gives AC 15 from 10 + Dexterity 3 + Wisdom 2. HP 10 is 8 + Constitution 2.
Hermit supplies Medicine, Religion, Elvish, and Discovery. Monk supplies Acrobatics and Insight. Siltcoil cannot wear armor or manipulate equipment.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based unarmed strike, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 piercing plus 1d4 poison.
Martial Arts. After a Bite made with the Attack action, Siltcoil can use a bonus action for a tail bump. +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 bludgeoning.
builds.tactics: Siltcoil meets intruders at the narrow end of the ford, strikes at close range, and swims away if overwhelmed.

builds.title: Roof watch, Fighter 2
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +4. Natural AC 14 is 11 + Dexterity 3. HP 20 is 12 at 1st level plus 8 at 2nd.
Soldier supplies Athletics, Intimidation, and Military Rank. Fighter supplies Perception and Survival. Loomstep has the Defense style and wears no armor, so it gives no bonus here.
Spider Climb allows difficult climbs and ceiling movement without a check. Web Walker removes the movement limits of webs.
actions: Bite. Dexterity-based unarmed strike, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+3 piercing plus 1d4 poison.

Web. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft. On a hit, the target is restrained. It may use an action to escape with a DC 12 Strength check. Destroying the web also frees it. Web AC 10, HP 5, resistance to bludgeoning, immunity to poison and psychic damage.
Second Wind. As a bonus action, regain 1d10+2 HP. One use per short or long rest.
Action Surge. Take one additional action on your turn. One use per short or long rest.
builds.tactics: Loomstep clings beneath the roof edge and webs the first creature to draw steel. If one attacker gets through, it uses Action Surge to bite or catch a second attacker.

builds.title: Orchard defender, Barbarian 1
traits: Proficiency +2. Strength and Constitution saves +4. Unarmored Defense gives AC 15 from 10 + Dexterity 3 + Constitution 2. HP 14 is 12 + 2.
Outlander supplies Athletics, Survival, Goblin, and Wanderer. Barbarian supplies Animal Handling and Perception. Cinderwing uses natural attacks and wears no armor.
actions: Sting. Strength-based unarmed strike, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d4+2 piercing plus 1d4 poison. While raging, piercing damage increases to 1d4+4. Cinderwing can instead use Dexterity for +5 to hit and 1d4+3 piercing plus 1d4 poison, without Rage damage.

Rage. As a bonus action, gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing, and +2 to damage with Strength-based melee weapon attacks, including the Strength-based Sting. Twice per long rest. Rage lasts up to 1 minute. It ends if Cinderwing falls unconscious, ends a turn without attacking a hostile creature or taking damage since its previous turn, or ends it with a bonus action.
builds.tactics: Cinderwing calls one warning from above the orchard wall. If the intruders press on it rages, strikes, and keeps to the outer edge of the fight.

concepts.name: Reedwatch
concepts.role: An owl that watches the ferry landing after dark.
concepts.motive: Find out why the ferryman’s bell keeps ringing after the last crossing.
concepts.hook: Reedwatch scratches a ferry sketch into loose mud and points to a second wake crossing the first.

concepts.name: Siltcoil
concepts.role: A serpent that guides travelers through a shifting ford.
concepts.motive: Recover the bridge records before the river takes the storehouse.
concepts.hook: Siltcoil gives directions from beneath the landing, then asks which traveler can read the lockbox seal.

concepts.name: Loomstep
concepts.role: A spider hired to watch the roofs along a market lane.
concepts.motive: Catch the thief who left false tracks to blame an apprentice.
concepts.hook: A silk line across the alley carries a scrap from the thief’s coat. Loomstep calls down to ask who recognizes the dye.

concepts.name: Cinderwing
concepts.role: A wasp that defends an orchard abandoned during the last harvest.
concepts.motive: Find the grower who taught it which fruit to leave for winter.
concepts.hook: Cinderwing offers the party its harvest if they can tell it where the grower moved.
